closed_findings.proof: layout.rs cover_output first checks signed output coordinate extents for every emitted lane, then limits sampled-axis coverage to min(neighborhood axis count, input texture rank). The 4×4 Texture2d -> 4×4×2 Texture3d Neighbors3D trigger now passes x/y coverage and z signed conversion/neighbor bounds; z is omitted only from sampled-axis equality. Existing grid/fetch/coordinate/neighbor source is byte-exact and freshly reread, preserving plane repetition for Clamp and Wrap.
closed_findings.arithmetic_qualification: A texture output extent is checked against i32::MAX for each emitted coordinate lane before the sampled-axis loop, including the projected-away z lane. Last valid coordinate is at most extent-1; both +/-1 are representable. For sampled lanes, existing grid extent and Wrap 2*extent-1 checks still prove modulo addition. Ignored z uses grid z=1 so modulo addition cannot overflow after representable coordinate addition. Buffer and Four use their unchanged bounded flattening/unflattening path instead.
